mapper.sql: o.opportunity_id, o.opportunity_no, o.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.business_registration_no, c.assigned_sales_id AS customer_assigned_sales_id, c.status AS customer_status, c.active AS customer_active, o.opportunity_name, o.stage, o.expected_revenue, o.expected_close_date, o.probability, o.owner_employee_id, e.employee_no AS owner_employee_no, e.employee_name AS owner_employee_name, o.status, o.description, o.created_at, o.updated_at, o.version

where.if: AND ( o.opportunity_no LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') OR o.opportunity_name LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') OR c.customer_name LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM sales_opportunity o INNER JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id INNER JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = o.owner_employee_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN o.status = 'OPEN' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, o.expected_close_date ASC, o.updated_at DESC, o.opportunity_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_opportunity o INNER JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
SELECT FROM sales_opportunity o INNER JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id INNER JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = o.owner_employee_id WHERE o.opportunity_id = #{opportunityId}

SELECT FROM sales_opportunity o INNER JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id INNER JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = o.owner_employee_id WHERE o.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY o.status ASC, o.updated_at DESC, o.opportunity_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sales_opportunity ( opportunity_no, customer_id, opportunity_name, stage, expected_revenue, expected_close_date, probability, owner_employee_id, status, description, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, version ) VALUES ( #{opportunity.opportunityNo}, #{opportunity.customerId}, #{opportunity.opportunityName}, #{opportunity.stage}, #{opportunity.expectedRevenue}, #{opportunity.expectedCloseDate}, #{opportunity.probability}, #{opportunity.ownerEmployeeId}, #{opportunity.status}, #{opportunity.description}, #{actorId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{actorId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE sales_opportunity SET opportunity_name = #{opportunityName}, stage = #{stage}, expected_revenue = #{expectedRevenue}, expected_close_date = #{expectedCloseDate}, probability = #{probability}, owner_employee_id = #{ownerEmployeeId}, status = #{status}, description = #{description}, updated_by = #{actorId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE opportunity_id = #{opportunityId} AND version = #{version}
